entries.title: EU sanctions Russian researchers involved in Navalny's death

entries.title: Germany: Merz rebukes Trump jab over defense at Baltic event

entries.title: Nigeria: US pulls some troops after anti-IS operation

entries.title: Google, Amazon emissions rise sharply, driven by AI boom

entries.title: Can inspectors return to Iran's nuclear sites?

entries.title: Sudan: Catastrophe unfolding in el-Obeid: UN rights envoy

entries.title: Germany: Voters are skeptical of reform proposals

entries.title: Monaco IDs suspect in bomb attack on Ukrainian oligarch

entries.title: Moldova: Prime Minister Munteanu resigns
